summary: A student brings the result of an association meeting to the council hearing that same day.
realLife: Elska Lunde reported that the university's undergraduate history association had voted to retain the ordinance and would consider a compromise for stores and shoppers.
inGame: The catalog supports city action on bottle deposits. needs: association vote and authority to negotiate.

turns.what: The student hands the secretary a record of the meeting.
turns.pulledBy: The council asks who authorized the statement.
turns.writesBack: The student gives the result from the association meeting.

turns.what: A council member asks whether the association has authorized this particular bargain.
turns.pulledBy: The council proposes a different compromise.
turns.writesBack: The student takes the proposal back without promising the association's votes.
